snippet.title: Lies of P: Overture - Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
Cross the bounds of time in Lies of P: Overture

They were waiting in the dark. Now they rise. Face fierce new bosses and carve your path through the shadows of Krat’s history. Lies of P: Overture is a brutal new expansion to the acclaimed Soulslike/Action RPG. 

Will you survive what came before? Available now.
https://www.liesofp.com/dlc-overture

🎭 Play Lies of P: Overture on Steam now to be the first to uncover what awaits:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2848330/Lies_of_P_Overture/

Follow us for more revelations/ Stay connected to follow the strings/threads:
